# Czech Fishing Trip Planner

Curated by Skill Harbor — a deep research skill for planning recreational fishing trips anywhere in Czechia: it finds fishing areas (revíry) across all 14 regions, compares ponds, rivers and reservoirs (Lipno, Slapy, Orlík, the Vltava, Morava and more), decodes the official revír data sheets — minimum sizes, seasons, and the Czech-language local restrictions that carry legal weight — explains licenses and permits (povolenky), and plans train and bus routes to the water via the Transitous API, drawing inline maps when useful. It answers in whatever language you write in, never in Czech by default. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @m4rt1n99. Honest caveats: Czechia only — no other country's waters; permit and rule details should be double-checked against official sources before traveling; 2 installs on the catalog, but popularity is not a review. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
